resources.string: Terrain is cached for offline use. Global coverage excludes the polar caps. Resolution varies; uncertain slopes remain unknown.
Derived from MDT05 · IGN/CNIG · CC BY 4.0. 5 m grid; source survey dates vary. Terrain models may miss bridges, stairs or recent changes.

Elevation uses downloaded terrain: IGN/CNIG where available, otherwise Mapzen. Missing or uncertain positions remain gaps. Global data is coarser and grades need longer observation. Original GPS heights stay in GPX exports. Prepare an offline area in Settings → Terrain maps.
